lines.zh: 贝吉特不紧不慢地迈步
lines.en: Vegetto walks without hurry.
His earrings sway with each step.

lines.zh: 他每一步都踩在节拍上
lines.en: Each step falls on its beat.

lines.zh: 橙蓝相间的衣摆在风里翻
lines.en: Orange and blue cloth turns in the wind.
Fists hang loose, fingers relaxed.
He takes one circuit of the clearing.
He surges, then eases off.
His aura flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 他走到哪里都像在中央
lines.en: Wherever he walks, it becomes centre stage.
His shadow trails long behind him.
He angles past a sapling.

lines.zh: 他走近时地面轻微震动
lines.en: The ground trembles slightly as he nears.
Vegetto stands with folded arms.
He exhales and his aura settles.
He tilts his head, assessing something.

lines.zh: 他的耳环碰在一起，轻响
lines.en: His earrings click together softly.
He lifts a hand to his brow.

lines.zh: 他的气在皮肤上跳了一层
lines.en: A layer of ki skips over his skin.
He clenches a fist, then lets it go.
His breathing stays deep and even.
He rolls his shoulders in place.

lines.zh: 他的目光扫过周围一圈
lines.en: His gaze sweeps the ground around.

lines.zh: 他忽然露出一个自信的笑
lines.en: A confident smile crosses his face.
He taps the ground twice with a toe.

lines.zh: 他站着，气场把四周压静
lines.en: He stands, and the air goes quiet.
He looks like he is waiting for a worthy foe.
Vegetto lifts his eyes to yours.

lines.zh: 他把你从头看到脚，很快
lines.en: He scans you top to bottom, fast.
The corner of his mouth rises.
He tilts his head, apparently amused.

lines.zh: 他朝你走近半步，很随意
lines.en: He drifts half a step closer.
He raises a hand and points at you.
He reads you right through.
He shakes his head with a laugh.
There is no tension in his eyes.

lines.zh: 他开口，却先说了一句客套
lines.en: He speaks, and starts with a courtesy.
He turns, yielding the space to you.
Assessment done, he takes a step back.

lines.zh: 他盯着你的手，防你先动
lines.en: He watches your hands for a first move.

lines.zh: 他的气围着你转了一圈
lines.en: His aura circles you once.

lines.zh: 他似乎在等你说明来意
lines.en: He seems to be waiting for your purpose.

lines.zh: 他的笑里没有敌意，也没温度
lines.en: No hostility in the smile, and no warmth.

lines.zh: 他把你和某个对手比较了一下
lines.en: He compares you to some past opponent.
A small nod, which counts as respect.

lines.zh: 贝吉特受了这一下，退了半步
lines.en: Vegetto takes it and gives half a step.
He wipes the corner of his mouth.
His aura frays briefly.
He narrows his eyes and reassesses.

lines.zh: 他活动了一下被打中的肩
lines.en: He rolls the shoulder that was hit.

lines.zh: 他吐出一口气，站得更稳
lines.en: He exhales and plants himself firmer.

lines.zh: 他的衣摆被撕开了一道
lines.en: His sash is torn open along one line.
He smiles, and it is not a happy one.
He yields a step, then takes it back.

lines.zh: 他的架势瞬间重新合拢
lines.en: His guard closes up again at once.

lines.zh: 贝吉特看了一眼你手上的东西
lines.en: Vegetto glances at what you hold.
He takes it in one clean motion.
He weighs it and hands it back.

lines.zh: 他闻了一下，没什么兴趣
lines.en: One sniff, and he loses interest.
Food holds little pull for him.
He waves it away, telling you to stow it.

lines.zh: 他收下了，算是给你面子
lines.en: He accepts it, as a courtesy.

lines.zh: 他笑你不用拿这个讨好他
lines.en: He laughs that you would bribe him.
He sets the item down on a stone.

lines.zh: 他看了一眼，就没再看第二眼
lines.en: One look, and never a second.

lines.zh: 你撞上贝吉特，他像堵墙
lines.en: You hit Vegetto; he is a wall.

lines.zh: 他被碰了一下，纹丝不动
lines.en: Touched, he does not shift.
He puts a hand out and steadies you.
His aura bounces you gently back.
He steps aside with economy.

lines.zh: 他的肩一碰，你退了半步
lines.en: A shoulder touch puts you half a step back.

lines.zh: 他退了半步，纯粹是礼让
lines.en: His half step back is pure courtesy.

lines.zh: 他低头看你有没有磕到
lines.en: He looks down to see if you are hurt.

lines.zh: 他的衣摆扫过你的小腿
lines.en: His sash brushes your calf.
He holds still and lets you go first.

lines.zh: 贝吉特和同伴并肩而立
lines.en: Vegetto stands shoulder to shoulder with his partner.
They exchange a single look.

lines.zh: 两人的气渐渐合到一处
lines.en: Their auras slowly merge.
He rests a hand on his partner's shoulder.

lines.zh: 他们同时向前迈了一步
lines.en: They step forward at the same moment.

lines.zh: 他退半步，把位置让出去
lines.en: He yields half a step of position.

lines.zh: 他们背对背站着，各看一边
lines.en: Back to back, each watches a side.
He takes the wind for his partner.

lines.zh: 他们没有说话，也不需要
lines.en: No words, and none needed.

lines.zh: 这样的配合不需要练习
lines.en: This kind of teamwork needs no practice.
Vegetto stoops to pick it up.
He spins it between his fingers.
He tosses it over to you.
What he does not want, he crushes.
He tucks the item into his clothing.

lines.zh: 他拾起时连腰都没怎么弯
lines.en: He barely bends to take it.

lines.zh: 他用脚尖把东西挑起来
lines.en: He flicks it up with a toe.
One glance, then he discards it.
He presses the prize flat and pockets it.

lines.zh: 拾取对他来说只是顺手
lines.en: Picking things up is a passing act.
Vegetto's aura flares wide.
He lifts his head and his eyes change.
Gravel lifts off the ground.
His fists clench with a crack.

lines.zh: 他的气浪把草压成一片
lines.en: His pressure lays the grass flat.

lines.zh: 他往前踏了一步，地面裂开
lines.en: One step forward cracks the earth.
White light gathers at his fingertips.
He has stopped smiling.
He sets into an opening stance.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸反而慢了下来
lines.en: His breathing actually slows.
The air begins to gather toward him.

lines.zh: 他的目光锁死在你身上
lines.en: His stare locks onto you.

lines.zh: 他侧身，把你放进最佳角度
lines.en: He turns to put you at the best angle.
He has already picked his first move.
He murmurs something under his breath.

lines.zh: 这一瞬间，他决定动手了
lines.en: In that instant he decides to fight.

lines.zh: 贝吉特瞬间消失在你眼前
lines.en: Vegetto vanishes from your view.
His afterimage stays behind.

lines.zh: 下一瞬，他已贴到你侧面
lines.en: An instant later he is on your flank.
He tries a quick jab.
He is testing your reflexes.
He circles with feather-light steps.
His aura presses in from all sides.

lines.zh: 他抬手，掌心对着你的胸口
lines.en: A palm aims at your chest.
He waits for one opening.

lines.zh: 他微微低头，像在算距离
lines.en: He ducks his head, calculating range.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，是给你机会
lines.en: He backs half a step, giving you a chance.
His smile is entirely certain.

lines.zh: 他把你逼向背后的空地
lines.en: He walks you into the open behind.
His footwork never repeats.

lines.zh: 他抬手拨开挡路的枝条
lines.en: He brushes a branch from his path.

lines.zh: 他在数你还有多少退路
lines.en: He is counting your remaining exits.

lines.zh: 他忽然停住，是准备出手
lines.en: The stop means he is about to move.

lines.zh: 空气被他的气挤得发紧
lines.en: The air tightens under his pressure.

lines.zh: 贝吉特一记直拳，快得没影
lines.en: His straight punch is a blur.

lines.zh: 他连打三下，位置全不同
lines.en: Three hits from three angles.
A kick lands on your flank.

lines.zh: 他抬手肘击，压在你的护甲上
lines.en: His elbow drives into your armour.
He traps your wrist and twists.

lines.zh: 他借转身加了一道横踢
lines.en: He adds a spin kick to the turn.

lines.zh: 他一掌推开，你退了很远
lines.en: A palm shove sends you far back.
He strikes and withdraws, no greed.
He deliberately lets you see it coming.
A knee, and it is almost gentle.

lines.zh: 他的气在拳上加了分量
lines.en: Ki adds weight behind the knuckles.
The miss turns into another strike.

lines.zh: 他两次假动作后才是真招
lines.en: Two feints, then the true blow.
He even steps back as he finishes.

lines.zh: 他的节奏始终握在自己手里
lines.en: The tempo is always his.

lines.zh: 这一下他只用了三分力
lines.en: That one carried a third of his power.
The sky darkens for an instant.
Vegetto drops out of the air.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击震起一圈尘土
lines.en: His landing throws up a ring of dust.
He straightens and his aura unfurls.

lines.zh: 他的耳环还在轻轻摇晃
lines.en: His earrings still sway.
Debris floats up on the current.
He looks up at the sky first.
He rolls his wrists as if warmed up.
He arrives without a sound.
The grass bends flat around his feet.
He settles his sash.

lines.zh: 他扫了一眼四周的地形
lines.en: He takes in the terrain at a glance.

lines.zh: 他看向你，眼神已经认真
lines.en: He looks at you, already serious.

lines.zh: 他的气把落叶卷成一个圈
lines.en: His aura spins the leaves in a ring.
Even his landing spot is chosen well.
He stands there as if waiting.

lines.zh: 他的出现让鸟群全飞了
lines.en: Birds scatter at his arrival.
A slight nod, and the match begins.

lines.zh: 火焰沾上衣袖，他随手拍灭
lines.en: Fire catches his sleeve; he swats it out.
He twists in the air to shed the impact.
Underwater he holds his breath, frowning.

lines.zh: 爆炸把他推得滑退数格
lines.en: The blast slides him back several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭被他两指夹住，还是擦破了皮
lines.en: He catches the arrow, but it still draws blood.

lines.zh: 怪力侵入，他闷哼了一声
lines.en: Odd force enters him; he grunts once.

lines.zh: 空腹让他出手慢了半拍
lines.en: An empty stomach costs him half a beat.
Lightning pours down; he grinds his teeth.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯，他爆气硬冲出来
lines.en: The void pulls; he blasts free.
